summary: Arrive AI Inc. filed a Form 8-K disclosing a Standstill Agreement with investor Streeterville Capital, LLC. The agreement restrains the investor from delivering purchase notices under existing Pre-Paid Purchases from May 14, 2026 to December 31, 2026, unless common stock trades at 15% above the Nasdaq Minimum Price. No cash or property was exchanged. The standstill terminates upon company breach or event of default. This is a passive financing amendment, not a special situation. Watch for any default triggers or stock price movements that could resume purchases.
